snippet.title: Shellshock Trailer - Official Gameplay Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
Our new game Shellshock is a first person anomaly game set during WW1 inspired by physiological horror and liminal spaces. 

You are a British soldier stuck in an endless loop, will you find your way out or will the loop take you? 

Available to Wish List on Steam now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4524800/Shellshock/
